description: Compares AI software for a known industry/task using published positions, reasons, best use cases, evidence and caveats. Use a scope from find_ai_solutions or industry/task discovery, including follow-ups such as why a product ranks first or the next page. Industry only returns a task directory; industry + task selects that exact scope; task only selects cross-industry. Missing combinations return not_found with guidance, never substitute rankings. Positions/scores are scoped, not comparable across scopes; unreviewed positions/scores are null. Top N corresponds to limit N rows.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

offset.description: Row offset. Use nextOffset from the previous response.

name: get_solution_rankings
